name: X Pos Bias (2.1 revival)
description: Adds a virtual x offset at level start so the X pos limit / Scroll Speed Bug shows up earlier, to roughly emulate 2.1-style high-TPS behavior.

enable-bias.name: Enable X position bias
enable-bias.description: Adds a fixed offset to x at level start so the X pos limit / SSB shows up earlier.

x-bias.name: X bias
x-bias.description: Extra virtual distance added at start. Bigger = bug appears sooner. Calibrate by testing, not by formula.
